impacts.description: Improved employability and career prospects of MSCA postdoctoral fellows within academia and beyond, contributing to a stronger and more mobile European research workforce.
impacts.inference_note: The source text states that increased skills and competences lead to 'improved employability and career prospects within academia and beyond'; the broader societal impact on research workforce quality and mobility is directly derivable from this stated outcome as a systemic effect at scale.

impacts.description: Increased and broadened research and innovation impact through enhanced networking and communication capacities with scientific peers and the general public.
Enhanced quality of European R&I through new mind-sets and approaches generated by international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary experience.
impacts.inference_note: The source states 'new mind-sets and approaches to R&I work forged through international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary experience'; the scientific quality impact at European R&I system level is a direct derivation of this individual-level outcome applied across the programme cohort.

impacts.description: Stronger R&I capacity and better knowledge transfer among participating organisations, contributing to the European Research Area's overall scientific output.
Increased global attractiveness and reputation of participating organisations and, by aggregation, of the European Research Area internationally.
Knowledge valorisation and innovation through integration of transferable skills, digital competences, and Open Science practices in research careers, linking academia to non-academic sectors.
impacts.inference_note: The scope text requires training activities to 'foster the culture of Open Science, knowledge valorisation' and 'when applicable innovation and entrepreneurship'; the economic impact on knowledge valorisation linking academia to the non-academic sector is a direct derivation of these mandatory training requirements.

impacts.description: Balanced brain circulation in widening countries and spreading of research excellence across the European Research Area through ERA Fellowships.
